scope_and_limits: These are ReplicaCAD stage-family/layout candidates, not verified independent homes or real-home generalization domains.
Archive contract audits are static only; Genesis import/render, camera safety, GT flow, radiance, and event coverage remain to be checked.

The train/validation roles are pilot-only and may be revised only before generation if a candidate has a documented import/geometry failure; no sample may be selected using either generator count or model score.
No training, real data, or ranking is performed by this registration.
selection_basis: first staging-00 configuration from three distinct ReplicaCAD stage families that passed the archive-level config/render/collision-reference closure check. No model outputs or EventGenesis/V2E counts used.
